Established in 2009, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading chemical company based in Minhang, Shanghai, China. With a strong commitment to innovation and quality, we have become a preferred partner for customers worldwide seeking high-quality chemical products.

At Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd., we specialize in the production and distribution of a wide range of chemicals, including pharmaceutical intermediates, catalysts, and reagents. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and experienced team of professionals ensure that we deliver products that meet the highest industry standards.

In addition to our product offerings, we also provide custom synthesis and contract manufacturing services to meet the specific needs of our customers. Our team of experts works closely with clients to develop customized solutions that align with their requirements and specifications.

Dedicated to sustainability and environmental responsibility, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. adheres to strict quality control measures throughout the production process. We are committed to reducing our carbon footprint and minimizing waste generation to contribute to a cleaner and greener future.

With a solid reputation for reliability and professionalism, Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is proud to be a trusted partner for customers in the chemical industry. Contact us today to learn more about our products and services.
